# 2 Baruch Chapter 87 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Baruch's Letters

---

**87:1** And-it-came-to-pass, when-the-eagle-had-been-sent-out and-had-flown-away, that-I, Baruch, went-to-the-oak-tree of-Mamre, beneath-which-Abraham, our-father, once-prayed-to-the-LORD, when-he-was-visited-by-his-angels; and-I-Baruch remained-there.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
